name: menu_items
evidence: checkmenuitems, drawmenuitems and createmenuitemempty: 256 records of 0x284 bytes. Item 0 is the back button of each menu: the menu loops end when it is pressed

name: menu_item_count
evidence: createmenuitemempty adds 1; the menu loops set it to 0 each frame

name: menu_item_index
evidence: checkmenuitems uses it as the loop index; the callbacks menutoggle, menuset and menuslider read it

name: textinput_start
evidence: menutextbox: the start of the selection in the text that the player edits

name: textinput_end
evidence: menutextbox: the end of the selection and the place of the cursor

name: textinput_text
evidence: menutextbox copies the value of a text field here and writes it back each frame. The Linux client names the record textinput

name: textinput_shown
evidence: drawmenuitems puts the text of a field here before it draws it, with stars for a password

name: menu_vertices
evidence: drawmenubutton and drawmenubutton2: the corners of the button, two floats each

name: menu_texcoords
evidence: drawmenubutton2: the texture corners of the 16 vertices

name: menu_alpha
evidence: drawmenubutton2: the alpha of each vertex, from 1 at the top to 0.25 at the bottom

name: menu_quad_count
evidence: drawmenubutton2: the number of quads in menu_quads

name: menu_quads
evidence: drawmenubutton2: four vertex numbers for each quad, 9 quads used

name: wrap_line_ends
evidence: 0x105b80 writes the index of the last character of each line of a wrapped text; drawmenutextfield reads it

name: client_account_id
evidence: connectmenu sends both ints after the name; joinmenu creates them with createclientaccount; the server finds the account by them

name: textinput_overwrite
evidence: addmenuinputchar: 0 inserts the letter, else the letter writes over the one at the cursor

name: wrap_line_count
evidence: formattextbox: the number of lines in wrap_line_ends

name: screen_bits
evidence: optionsmenu: the color depth of the window, 16 or 32; the mode test compares it with the bits of each video mode

name: screen_fullscreen
evidence: optionsmenu: 1 when the window is fullscreen; Apply writes it and passes it to SDL_SetWindowFullscreen

name: joystick_names
evidence: optionsmenu writes the input names: 0x200 bytes for each device, 16 for each name (axes of devices 1 and 2, 16 buttons of device 3, hats of device 4)

name: join_servers
evidence: joinmenu: the servers that answered a ping; the list has no size test

name: join_server_count
evidence: joinmenu: the number of join_servers

name: join_addresses
evidence: joinmenu: the addresses to ping: the LAN and Direct IP ones, then the master list (at most 0x1fff in one packet)

name: join_address_count
evidence: joinmenu: the number of join_addresses

name: join_master_first
evidence: joinmenu: the master list replaces the addresses from this index

name: join_columns
evidence: joinmenu: x and y of the list columns: name, players, ping, version, game type

name: join_debug
evidence: joinmenu with debugit: the first two addresses and the address count

name: gl_create_program
evidence: pointer to glCreateProgramObjectARB that the extension loader fills; mainmenu makes 32 programs

name: gl_create_shader
evidence: pointer to glCreateShaderObjectARB that the extension loader fills

name: gl_gen_buffers
evidence: pointer to glGenBuffersARB that the extension loader fills; mainmenu makes 0x1000 buffer pairs

name: gl_gen_framebuffers
evidence: pointer to glGenFramebuffers that the extension loader fills

name: gl_gen_renderbuffers
evidence: pointer to glGenRenderbuffers that the extension loader fills

name: vbo_next
evidence: mainmenu: the next free buffer number; 0 and 1 go to sector_vbo and sector_shadow_vbo

name: framebuffer_ready
evidence: mainmenu writes 1 next to framebuffer_index; no reader

name: vbo_spare_a
evidence: mainmenu gives it the buffer number 2; no reader

name: vbo_spare_b
evidence: mainmenu gives it the buffer number 4; no reader

name: vbo_spare_c
evidence: mainmenu gives it the buffer number 5; no reader

name: camera_velocity
evidence: mainmenu passes it to soundsimulation as the velocity of the listener

name: version_marks
evidence: joinmenu: the mark of a server of this version and the mark of another version
